create_nested_dictionary_dataset: create a NestedDictionaryDataset from a nested dict of FairseqDataset objects with matching lengths
flatten_nested_dict: use _flatten to recursively flatten a nested dictionary into dot-separated keys
unflatten_dict: use _unflatten to reconstruct a nested dictionary from dot-separated flattened keys
collate_samples: call collater on a NestedDictionaryDataset to merge samples into a mini-batch for model forwarding
prefetch_dataset_indices: call prefetch on a NestedDictionaryDataset to pre-load data for the given sample indices
